heading: INT. ADRAKA MEDICAL UNIVERSITY – SYSTEMS LAB – DAY – YEARS EARLIER
boundary: A futuristic medical laboratory built within an old red-stone university.

env6.rule: Holographic patient/system model is literal teaching display; no alternate event, transformed site, simulated reality or represented layer.

characters.ANARVAA: student; composed, ambitious, immaculately organised; exact age/costume controlled-unresolved
characters.PARVARAN: student; thoughtful, curious, visibly idealistic; exact age/costume controlled-unresolved

camera_ranges: systems-lab establish + literal hologram teaching display 32-70mm
literal hologram freeze + Lab Assistant physical technology failure
resolve.bindings: ENV-ADK-001 physical lab only; literal holographic neural/patient/system teaching display; no SB grammar.
resolve.technology: Suspended holographic neural maps + patient systems model + console. Model shows Hospital/Police/Court/Shelter and freezes due technology failure; no simulated world.
resolve.screen_direction: Marsyaa fronts students; Anarvaa and Parvaran share teaching axis; hologram centered between/near them; Lab Assistant at console.

default.prompt: Approved SC006 Adraka Medical University Systems Lab years-earlier chronology; old red-stone university architecture with carved wood beams and literal futuristic holographic medical teaching displays; photoreal restrained realism 3840x1600 2.40:1; preserve Marsyaa mentor, Anarvaa organized ambition, Parvaran idealism; hologram is technology not alternate reality.
default.audio: creator-recorded dialogue only; physical lab room tone, console/hologram source sounds; no subjective layer
default.remotion: 3s/90f; CUT; no crop; SH040 out CUT_TO_SC007

shots: Establish futuristic medical laboratory inside old red-stone university
Carved wooden ceiling beams coexist with suspended holographic neural maps
Reveal Marsyaa in his fifties before two brilliant students
Introduce Anarvaa: composed, ambitious, immaculately organised
Introduce Parvaran: thoughtful, curious, visibly idealistic
Literal holographic model displays distressed patient across Hospital/Police/Court/Shelter
Patient repeatedly falls through gaps between four departments
PARVARAN: During a crisis, the patient disappears between four departments.
ANARVAA: Then we must connect the departments.
Marsyaa distinguishes connection from single authority
MARSYAA: Connecting them is one thing. Giving them to a single authority is another.
Four systems merge into one circle on hologram
ANARVAA: If emergency response has a single command, the delay will reduce.
Anarvaa says acute risk may make consent impossible
ANARVAA: During acute risk, consent may not always be possible.
Marsyaa says that is why boundary is needed
MARSYAA: That is exactly why we need a boundary.
Holographic neural maps retain teaching-display scale
No site transformation; old university architecture remains visible
Patient model remains literal instructional content
Lab Assistant reports integrated model hung
LAB ASSISTANT: Sir... the integrated model has hung again.
Marsyaa jokes even machine understood boundary
MARSYAA: Even the machine has understood the boundary.
Parvaran suppresses smile; Anarvaa does not
Anarvaa rejects technology failure as philosophy
ANARVAA: Do not turn a technology failure into philosophy, sir.
Marsyaa asks what happens when authority fails
MARSYAA: Will you say the same when authority fails?
A beat between mentor and students
MARSYAA (CONT’D): Let the hospital heal. Let the police protect. Let the court decide.
Marsyaa warns one hand doing all jobs erases citizenship
MARSYAA (CONT’D): If one hand does all three jobs, the patient will no longer remain a citizen.
Parvaran asks how to coordinate; Marsyaa answers shared responsibility
PARVARAN: Then how do we coordinate? | MARSYAA: Shared responsibility.
Marsyaa turns to Anarvaa: not shared power; exact SC006 end
